newsitem.title: GREECE: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) RAISES GASOLINE PRICES.
newsitem.headline: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) RAISES GASOLINE PRICES.

text.p: Greece's Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) will raise gasoline prices by 1.20 drachmas per litre, effective on Thursday May 1.
Transport diesel and heating fuel prices will also rise by 0.8 and 0.6 drachmas per litre, DEP said.

The price adjustments come after higher world gasoline prices, up by $1.7 per metric tonne, along with firmer world diesel prices and a stronger dollar/drachma exchange rate, it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
